words: Pattern: one structure repeated all the way round a centre or along a turning axis. Examples: spokes or a tyre around a wheel hub, the threads of a screw or bolt, the coils of a tail or a snake, a shaggy dog's hair spreading round its nose (schnauzer, Shih Tzu). Not: flat discs such as clocks, flowers, smooth-coated dogs or white pointed-eared dogs.
